build_qwen2vl_attention: build a Qwen2VLAttention module using tensor parallel QKV linear layers and flash attention for vision transformer attention
build_qwen2visionmodel: build a Qwen2VisionModel with 3D patch embedding, rotary positional embeddings, and vision transformer blocks for image feature extraction
build_qwen2vl_for_conditional_generation: build a Qwen2VLForConditionalGeneration model combining vision encoder and Qwen2 text model for multimodal text generation
create_get_position_ids: create position IDs for mixed vision-text segments using image grid dimensions and spatial merge size
create_get_vision_embeds: create vision embeddings from pixel values using the visual model and image grid temporal-height-width tensor
